description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for verifying the behavior of git add and git commit commands with various wildcard and literal patterns, primarily focusing on pathspecs including wildcards like '*', '**', '?', and character classes, as well as escaped characters and literal patterns. It includes setup functions, test cases, and checks for proper listing and committing of files matching specific patterns.

methods.name: prepare_test_files
methods.description: Creates a set of test files with various wildcard-relevant names to test pathspec matching.
